description: This file contains unit tests for threading functionality within the WPEFramework project, including classes for thread management and job dispatching, utilizing Google Test framework.

classes.name: ThreadClass
classes.description: A custom thread class derived from Core::Thread, designed for testing thread behavior and synchronization.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class implementing Core::IDispatch, used for testing job dispatching and synchronization.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Overrides Core::Thread::Worker to perform thread work, signaling completion via condition variable.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Implements Core::IDispatch::Dispatch to signal job completion.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the thread job, specifically whether it has completed.
